member.name: M:BCKash.Api.Controllers.ClientsController.SafeDisplayName(BCKash.Domain.Clients.Client)
member.summary: `display_name`/`full_name` are legacy denormalized columns that, on real imported data, are routinely blank — never populated by whatever process wrote the original rows. Rather than have every consumer of this API re-derive a fallback (and risk the same bug the control portal hit, where a blank-but-non-empty stored value defeats a naive `||` fallback), the response's DisplayName is always a real name: the stored value if it's non-blank, otherwise FirstName + LastName computed here once.
